name: Address_Points_from_National_Address_Database
description: The Address Points from National Address Database dataset was compiled on June 30, 2026 by the US Department of Transportation. The National Address Database (NAD) is a spatial database containing address data, point location coordinates, jurisdictions, record-level metadata and other supporting data for addressable locations including structures, some sub-units within those structures, and landmarks as included in the aggregated datasets from providers included therein.
